claims.verbatim:
Steamship The Queen (Br.), Grogan, Liverpool April 18, Queens-
town 19th, with mdse. and 1,268[?] pass. to the National Steam Naviga-
tion Company. April 19, off Roche's Point, passed steamship Hel-
vetia, bound E.; same time, steamships California and City of Balti-
more, for Liverpool. 20th, lat. 51 21, lon. 11 44, steamship China, [cut]
bound E. 21st, lat. 50 45, lon. 16 32, passed a bark-rigged steamer
bound E. 23d, lat. 48 04, lon. 29 16, steamship Scotland bound E. 25th,
lat. 45, lon. 39 22, ship Universe, bound E. 26th, lat. 43 55, lon. 65[?] 01,
a steamer bound W., supposed to be the City of London. 30th, lat.
40 53, lon. 65 12, passed a boat painted green, bottom up. 1st inst.,
lat. 40 42, lon. 68 43, passed a bark-rigged steamer, red funnel, red top,
bound E.
